alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme covers Groningen's broad business-administration and Business and Management core. Two further formal specialisations are generator-backed and support coherent UCR responses: a technology, data and digital-business route and a finance, accounting and decision-analysis route. Pairwise differences are 60 EC, 67.5 EC and 45 EC; all exceed the 30-EC floor and reflect different academic organising logics. The maximum of three alternatives is reached.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Groningen studies operations management. UCR’s product-design course contributes practical experience with prototyping and production scale.
Both study marketing planning, customer needs and the marketing mix.
Groningen extends management and organization theory in the final year.
Groningen has a dedicated management science course. UCR develops related quantitative techniques across several courses.
Groningen offers dedicated study of supply chain operations.
Groningen studies recruitment, motivation and job design. UCR examines workplace psychology and leadership.
Both study motivation, group behavior and leadership in organizations.
Groningen studies strategy at several organizational levels. UCR offers related work in negotiation and digital strategy.
Groningen studies management and organization theory in a dedicated course. UCR covers related behavior and strategy in separate courses.
Groningen studies organization and technology together. UCR explores the effects of AI and digital change in business.
Groningen connects organizational change and leadership. UCR addresses these through several management courses.
Groningen includes a dedicated consulting course.
Both use accounting and financial reports to understand business decisions.
Groningen covers financial management in a dedicated course. UCR develops related skills across accounting, corporate finance and financial markets.
Both use microeconomics to study firms, markets and decisions. UCR emphasizes behavior as well.
Groningen has a separate management accounting course.
